messages:
maya: quick check — int4 bring-up for model rwin-v2-3 (onboarded yesterday) is showing a small but consistent uptick in hallucination rate on AB at 1% traffic. details below.
kevin: can you paste the AB metrics slice? where are we seeing it (summaries, long-form qna)?
sam: +1 to kevin — small deltas can hide slice-specific regressions.
maya: short snippet: "hallucination_rate": baseline 1.2% -> rwin-v2-3-int4 2.1% (Δ +0.9%), win_rate drop on factual QA -4.3pp. sample size ~5k requests.
kevin: that's non-trivial. are we seeing token-level loss shifts?
maya: token_loss delta +0.06 on long-form (>512 tokens). topk/temperature unchanged. inference logs show occasional entropic loops, eg: "User: what's the origin of X? Model: X is ... X is ..." (attached two short transcripts).
alex: could be quantization bias around certain token embeddings or the KV-cache precision. did we run the posterior calibration / roundtrip tests?
maya: ran nll parity on short prompts — passed. failures concentrated on multi-step reasoning + knowledge lookup prompts (reasoning_longform slice).
sam: sounds like a slice-specific degradation — we should gate the canary. propose: require both (1) hallucination_rate delta < 0.5pp and (2) win_rate >= baseline -1pp at canary 1%. auto-fallback if either fails.
kevin: agree. concretely: hallucination_delta_threshold = 0.5, win_rate_threshold = -1.0 (pp), min_samples = 2000. on fail -> immediate fallback to fp16 variant + alert SRE. also run quiet-burn shadow for 24h to get more coverage.
maya: draft rollout config below: 
```yaml
canary:
  variant: rwin-v2-3-int4
  traffic: 1%
  min_samples: 2000
  metrics:
    - name: hallucination_rate
      delta_threshold: 0.5
      comparator: absolute
    - name: win_rate
      delta_threshold: -1.0
      comparator: relative
  on_fail:
    - action: fallback
      target: rwin-v2-3-fp16
      notify: ["#eng-ml", "@sre-oncall"]
    - action: hold
      tag: int4-hold
```
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary(rwin-v2-3-int4) @ 1% -> canary_ts=2641597600 :rocket:
maya: will monitor. i'll run targeted eval set (reasoning/kb) every 15m and post slices.
alex: add regression alerting for "reasoning_longform" slice + enable trace sampling 5% for those requests so we can inspect attention patterns.
kevin: if fallback triggers, also run introspective eval to compare token attention / logits distribution between fp16 and int4. assign: maya + sam.
maya: noted. starting periodic evals now — will drop updates here. :eyes:
